query: What is required to maintain Permanent Residence (PR) status?
reference_answer: A Singapore permanent resident (SPR) who wishes to leave Singapore must obtain a Re-Entry Permit (REP) to enable him/her to return to Singapore as a SPR.  A SPR who remains outside Singapore without a valid REP will lose his/her PR status.
context:
[Document 1]
You can sponsor your parent(s) for Singapore Permanent Residence (PR) only if you are a Singapore citizen.

[Document 2]
Singapore Permanent Residents (PR) are eligible to apply for Singapore citizenship two years after being granted Singapore PR status.

[Document 3]
If you have submitted your application on or after 26 June 2024, you may log in to the ICA e-Service with your reference number to check the status of your Singapore Citizenship, Permanent Residence or Long-Term Visit Pass application.You will be redirected to the Case Summary page where you can check your status enquiry.

[Document 4]
You may consider submitting a fresh application for permanent residence online if there are changes to your circumstances.

[Document 5]
There is no provision to reinstate the PR status of those who have renounced their status voluntarily. If you are Interested to become a Singapore PR again, you may submit a fresh application to us for consideration if you meet the prevailing application criteria for PR.
answer: To maintain Permanent Residence (PR) status, you need to apply for Singapore citizenship after two years, or submit a fresh application if your circumstances change. There's no reinstatement option for those who voluntarily renounced their PR status. [Document 5]
